name: Settlement Date 8 Code
definition: Specifies the date of settlement, in coded form.

ASAP.name: As Soon As Possible
ASAP.definition: Transfer is to be effected as soon as possible.

ENDC.name: At End Of Contract
ENDC.definition: Transfer is to be effected at the end of the contract.

CASH.name: Cash
CASH.definition: Settlement takes place on the trade date.

CLEA.name: Cleared
CLEA.definition: Cash settlement takes place before trade date.

MONT.name: End Of Month
MONT.definition: Settlement takes place at the end of the month.

FUTU.name: Future
FUTU.definition: Settlement takes place on the trade date plus six or more business days.

PRVD.name: Previous Day
PRVD.definition: Event occurs on the previous day.

REGU.name: Regular
REGU.definition: Settlement takes place under the standard rules applicable to the market and instrument.

SAVE.name: Savings Plan
SAVE.definition: Money is withdrawn automatically from the savings plan.

SELL.name: Sellers Option
SELL.definition: Settlement takes place at the choice/option of the seller.

TBAT.name: To Be Announced Trade
TBAT.definition: Settlement takes place as a result of a "to be announced" trade.

TFIV.name: T Plus Five
TFIV.definition: Settlement takes place on the trade date plus five business days.

TFOR.name: T Plus Four
TFOR.definition: Settlement takes place on the trade date plus four business days.

TONE.name: T Plus One
TONE.definition: Settlement takes place on the trade date plus one business day.

TTRE.name: T Plus Three
TTRE.definition: Settlement takes place on the trade date plus three business days.

TTWO.name: T Plus Two
TTWO.definition: Settlement takes place on the trade date plus two business days.

WHIF.name: When And If Issued
WHIF.definition: Settlement takes place when the financial instrument is issued by the issuer.

WDIS.name: When Distributed
WDIS.definition: Settlement takes place when the financial instrument is distributed.

WISS.name: When Issued
WISS.definition: Settlement is to be done when the security is issued.

WHID.name: When Issued Or Distributed
WHID.definition: Settlement takes place when the financial instrument is issued or distributed.
